headword: {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}
gloss: global warming countermeasures; climate change measures

definitions.gloss: global warming countermeasures; climate change measures; anti-warming initiatives
definitions.explanation: Actions, policies, and technologies aimed at preventing or mitigating global warming. Encompasses both reducing greenhouse gas emissions and adapting to climate change impacts.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}を{強化|きょうか}した。
examples.english: The government strengthened its global warming countermeasures.

examples.japanese: {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}として{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギーの{普及|ふきゅう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: The spread of renewable energy is advancing as a climate change measure.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}も{個人|こじん}も、それぞれの{立場|たちば}で{温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}に{取|と}り{組|く}むことが{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: Both companies and individuals are expected to work on global warming countermeasures from their respective positions.

notes:
A compound of {温暖化|おんだんか} (warming, as in global warming) and {対策|たいさく} (countermeasures, measures). This is the standard Japanese term used in policy documents, news, and everyday discussion about addressing climate change.

The full formal phrase is {地球温暖化対策|ちきゅうおんだんかたいさく} (global warming countermeasures), but {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく} is the common shortened form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to work on warming countermeasures
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}を{推進|すいしん}する: to promote anti-warming initiatives
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}{基本法|きほんほう}: Basic Act on Global Warming Countermeasures
- {温暖化対策|おんだんかたいさく}の{一環|いっかん}として: as part of warming countermeasures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}: global warming — the phenomenon itself
- {気候変動対策|きこうへんどうたいさく}: climate change measures — a broader term covering all climate-related actions
- {環境対策|かんきょうたいさく}: environmental measures — broader environmental protection efforts
